tender.title: BLC0222 - National Firearms Licensing Management System (NFLMS)
tender.description:
This Invitation to Tender (“ITT”) has been issued by BlueLight Commercial (“BLC”) who are seeking to award a Contract for the provision of a National Firearms Licensing Management System (NFLMS).   BLC will be tendering this requirement on behalf of Police Digital Services (“PDS”) for use by themselves and the Additional Authorities defined in the Terms and Conditions of the contract. 
The requirement will be tendered via a multi-stage Competitive Flexible Process, under the Procurement Act 2023 (“PA23”), with the intention of awarding a contract to a single supplier.  The Contract Term shall be for an initial period of 5 years with options to extend up to a maximum of 10 years. 
Bidders must register on the Central Digital Platform (www.gov.uk/find-tender) and ensure that Core Supplier Information is up to date, downloaded and is submitted as part of the Bid submission (in downloaded file format) in order to be assessed against the Conditions of Participation.

procedure.features:
The competitive flexible procedure consists of the following 2 stages:
STAGE 1 – Tender Stage
STAGE 2 – Demonstration Stage
STAGE 1 – TENDER STAGE
The Tender Stage consists of the following:
Conditions of Participation – this is a series of pass/fail questions relating to the requirement of the procurement.
Gateway Technical Questions – this is a series of technical Pass/Fail questions relating to the product and service required.   
ITT Technical Questions - 55 % – this is completion of the Response to Tender document consisting of questions relating to Design, Cyber, Implementation and Delivery, Service, and Solution.
Social Value – 10% - this is the completion of the Response to Tender document consisting of questions relating to Social Value.
Price – 30% - this is the completion of the Pricing Schedule which is based on a schedule of rates for the services required.
All bidders that PASS all Conditions of Participation AND Tender Gateway Questions AND achieve a minimum score of 40% for the ITT Technical Questions will progress to Stage 2 of the Procurement Process.
STAGE 2 – DEMONSTRATION
The Demonstration Stage consists of a scenario-based demonstration.  A Demonstration Briefing document has been published with the full suite of tender documentation to aid understanding.
The Demonstration score will be added to the score from Stage 1 to form the Total Score and identify the Highest Scoring Bidder.  The Highest Scoring Bidder will be awarded the contract.  In the event of a tie where two or more bidders achieve the same total aggregate score the Highest Scoring Bidder for the Solution sub-criteria shall be awarded the contract.

tender.title: BLC0222 - National Firearms Licensing Management System (NFLMS)
tender.description:
This Contract Award Notice issued by BlueLight Commercial Ltd ("BLC"), on behalf of Police Digital Services ("PDS") for the provision of a replacement National Firearms Licensing Management System ("NFLMS") on behalf of themselves as the Contracting Authority and the Additional Authorities defined in the Terms and Conditions of the contract.  The NFLMS will enable all 43 Police Forces in England & Wales, to record the grant, renewal, and revocation of firearms licenses.  The NFLMS will also hold Home Office licensing information relating to explosives, explosive precursors, and poisons.  The contract may be modified to include Police Scotland and the Police Service of Northern Ireland (PSNI) if required.
The services will be delivered by a single supplier.

The deadline for this tender response has been extended, following amendments to the specification, by 14 days. This provides more than 25 days between the date of this amendment to the date of tender submission. Amendments to the specification will be provided via the In-Tend portal.

Pre-market engagement was undertaken in relation to this procurement by the Home Office under Public Contract Regulations 2015, and all relevant outputs have been built into the Statement of Requirements.  The Authority is satisfied that:

(b) competition in relation to the award of the public contract is not otherwise distorted.
